verses.text: To the choir director: on the stringed instruments, on the octave. A Psalm of David

tok.t: To the choir director: on the stringed instruments, on the octave. A

verses.text: O Jehovah, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor chasten me in Your burning wrath.
Be gracious to me, O Jehovah, for I am languishing; Heal me, O Jehovah, for my bones are shaken,
And my soul is greatly shaken. But as for You, O Jehovah, how long?

verses.text: Return, O Jehovah; deliver my soul; Save me for Your lovingkindness’ sake.
For in death there is no remembrance of You; In Sheol who can give thanks to You?

tok.t: of You; In Sheol who can give

verses.text: I am weary with my groaning; Every night I cause my bed to swim; With my tears I dissolve my couch.
My eye is wasted because of grief; It has aged because of all those who vex me.

tok.t: ; It has aged because of all those who vex me.

verses.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, For Jehovah has heard the sound of my weeping.
Jehovah has heard my supplication; Jehovah receives my prayer.
All my enemies will be ashamed and greatly dismayed; They will turn back; they will be put to shame suddenly.

tok.t: and greatly dismayed; They will turn back; they will be put to shame
